source_records.title: Loro Rust API, implementation and adjacent native tests
source_records.version_context: loro/loro-internal 1.16.2; wrapper package VCS af130d97d8b110add13283fc5bfc81d97a9a609f; archive digests in evidence

source_records.independent_observation: Native Rust API supports move, import, causal frontier comparison and historical checkout. Commit groups history/events and is not a durable ACID flush. Checkout detaches state. Selected native tests exercise move and snapshot/update import.
source_records.governing_condition_and_applicability: Storage, relay, business conflict recording and approval are app responsibilities. Reattach before ordinary editing if checkout was used. Code/tests were inspected but not run.

source_records.title: Loro peer identity
source_records.independent_observation: New document instances default to random writer identity; operation identity combines peer and counter. Concurrent reuse risks collisions.
source_records.governing_condition_and_applicability: Intentional reuse requires restoring matching local history before remote updates and preventing concurrent emitters. Final states library-safe reuse/single-writer condition and tests copied profiles.

source_records.title: Loro shallow history boundary
source_records.locator: Synchronization Limitations; Archive and Trim; Best Practices
source_records.independent_observation: A trimmed document cannot synchronize a peer whose version predates its retained boundary. Full history archiving and coordinated trimming are documented.
source_records.governing_condition_and_applicability: Long-offline retention is consequential. Control preserves full snapshots and postpones shallow snapshots until an owner-approved safe boundary.
